name: ip_geolocation
description: Look up geographic location and ISP info for an IP address, look up multiple IPs at once, or get the server's own current public IP and location.

action.description: lookup: one IP's location. bulk_lookup: multiple IPs at once. my_ip: the server's own current public IP/location.

ip_address.description: A single IP address. Required for action='lookup'.

ip_addresses.description: Multiple IP addresses. Required for action='bulk_lookup'.
